deadline.intake: Autumn 2027 (studies start 1 Sept 2027); end of registration for the HSE International Olympiad tuition-free track

tuition.note: Bachelor's in International Business (taught in English), per year, 2026; fee-paying studies at HSE start from 200,000 RUB per year depending on programme

requirement.text: International Business bachelor's (taught in English): entry by Unified State Exam, olympiad results or HSE internal tests; minimum USE scores for foreign citizens are Mathematics 65 and English 70; secondary education required. Tuition-free places are possible through the HSE International Olympiad and Russian government scholarship programmes.
